description: Defines the QuicMemoryCacheBackend class for in-memory HTTP response caching, including resource management, response addition, and backend interface implementation.

classes.name: QuicMemoryCacheBackend
classes.description: In-memory cache for HTTP responses, managing responses, server push resources, and backend interface functions.

classes.name: ResourceFile
classes.description: Manages loading a resource file into memory, including headers, body, and push URLs.

methods.name: GetResponse
methods.description: Retrieves a cached response for a given host and path.

methods.name: AddSimpleResponse
methods.description: Adds a simple response with headers and body to the cache.

methods.name: AddSimpleResponseWithServerPushResources
methods.description: Adds a simple response along with server push resources.

methods.name: AddResponse
methods.description: Adds a response with headers and body to the cache.

methods.name: AddResponseWithEarlyHints
methods.description: Adds a response with 103 Early Hints.

methods.name: AddSpecialResponse
methods.description: Adds a special response at a particular path.

methods.name: SetResponseDelay
methods.description: Sets a simulated delay for a response.

methods.name: AddDefaultResponse
methods.description: Sets a default response for cache misses.

methods.name: GenerateDynamicResponses
methods.description: Enables responses that generate a specified number of bytes dynamically.

methods.name: GetServerPushResources
methods.description: Retrieves server push resources associated with a request URL.

methods.name: InitializeBackend
methods.description: Initializes the backend cache from a directory.

methods.name: IsBackendInitialized
methods.description: Checks if the backend is initialized.

methods.name: FetchResponseFromBackend
methods.description: Fetches a response based on request headers and body.
